decisions.statement: Inference runs on machines outside the cluster.
An inference machine is reached over the private network.
One model is loaded at a time.
Loading a second model evicts the first.
A few services are marked warm and are not evicted for each other.
One inference runs at a time.
How many models are resident does not change how many inferences run at once.
A model is loaded before its service reports healthy rather than on the first request.

definition: the services that run models and keep a record of every run
